messages:
taylor: hi team, new hire here. need console staging + ability to flip a flag for a quick integration smoke during onboarding. who do I ask? :wave:
rachel: welcome @taylor! ping infra-ops. when you flip flags try to use the onboard_canary segment, not full rollout.
taylor: thanks! email is taylor.green@redwood.com. also would like to download a small slice of audit logs for the test.
infra-ops: sending a temporary grant: 'console-staging-editor' for 6h and 'console-audit-reader' for 6h. watch for invite email. note: audit exports need security approval if they include user ids.
platform-bot: role grant completed for taylor: console-staging-editor (expires in 6h). :white_check_mark:
taylor: I can access staging but /admin/flags gives me read-only. I need write to toggle one flag for the test.
infra-ops: adding you to 'console-feature-editors' now. should be effective in 90s due to cache.
pm-aya: hi @taylor, heads up from PM side: please add a one-line test plan in ENG-ONBOARD ticket and tag me. keep the toggle window short.
taylor: opened ENG-ONBOARD-1342 with plan + rollback. tagging @pm-aya.
security: if you want to export audit rows that contain email or user ids, please fill the data export form attached in the ticket. otherwise we can provide a redacted CSV.
taylor: redacted CSV is fine. thanks. quick question: is curl the recommended method to programmatically toggle?
rachel: we prefer flag-cli for scripted toggles (it adds audit headers automatically). example:
```
flag-cli toggle --env staging --flag payments.beta_ui --segment onboard_canary --operator taylor.green --ttl 30m
```
this will create an auditable action and auto-revert after 30m.
taylor: tested flag-cli, worked great. ran smoke, no regressions. exported redacted audit, attached to ENG-ONBOARD-1342.
infra-ops: role will auto-expire; if you need extended access open a request with justification.
pm-aya: added note to onboarding doc about using flag-cli & redacted exports. welcome aboard! :tada:
